summary: Implements ADR-017 clauses 2, 3, and 4: the per-selector badge value allowlist is now applied in the renderer. BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed performs the match (empty allowlist means no restriction; otherwise the resolved pre-template value is trimmed and compared by case-insensitive ordinal exact match, with no substring, wildcard, prefix, or regex matching). BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve applies the filter to each resolved pre-template technical value and to the fixed UpgradePending status text before applying the definition template, giving the documented order value resolution -> allowlist filter -> definition template -> normalization/truncation -> layout. The filter applies to each retained CustomBadge value independently and to the full Audio composite. Unknown/absent values remain omitted and the filter never widens an omission; an allowlisted value that cannot fit still follows the existing shorten/omit behavior. RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion stays 1, RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion stays 2, and no golden was regenerated (task 12.4); the empty-allowlist default goldens are unchanged.
